codeReview.summary: Commit f148fcb satisfies the feature requirements. `package.json` now builds `dist/nya` without externalizing the optional Ink devtools dependency and includes `react-devtools-core`, which removes the runtime hole that prevented the offline artifact from starting (`package.json:9,31`). The post-build asset script makes `dist/nya` directly executable via a Bun shebang and `chmod 755`, then copies the core `web-tree-sitter.wasm` plus all grammar wasm files into `dist/tree-sitter` (`scripts/copy-tree-sitter-assets.ts:12-53`). The new integration test exercises the required offline evidence path by running `bun run build`, invoking `dist/nya --help`, invoking `dist/nya db doctor --project --json --no-tui` from an isolated temp directory, asserting runtime assets exist, and confirming tree-sitter chunking works when resolving assets from the dist runtime directory (`tests/build-artifact.test.ts:51-121`).

sharedStateObservations.observation: Shared-state docs do not currently record the dist runtime asset lookup contract for tree-sitter. Future workers touching build/dist behavior may need to rediscover that chunking resolves wasm assets relative to the executing entrypoint directory.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: The worker transcript shows explicit inspection of `src/core/chunking/chunk-code-tree-sitter.ts` before implementation, and the code resolves `<runtimeDir>/tree-sitter/*.wasm` from `process.argv[1]` (`src/core/chunking/chunk-code-tree-sitter.ts:245-281`). `.factory/library/architecture.md` mentions Tree-sitter chunking generally but does not document the dist-runtime asset resolution rule.
